items.title: The campaign that kick-started the net zero movement is shifting focus

items.title: Government funnels £130m into zero-emission vehicles as Mandate consultation looms
items.summary: The Government has earmarked £130m to help UK markets ramp up innovative zero-emission vehicle technologies, although reports suggest a consultation will be launched that could lessen the ambition of the Zero Emission Vehicle (ZEV) Mandate.

items.title: Amazon deforestation alerts reach record lows
items.summary: The Amazon has recorded the smallest area under deforestation alerts ever in 2026, a drop of 36% compared to the previous year.

Climate disclosure across the OECD: Why the US risks becoming the exception
items.summary: With the comment period on the SEC’s proposal to rescind its 2024 climate disclosure rules now closed, the United States is on course to become the only major OECD market moving to remove, rather than refine, a federal investor-facing climate reporting framework.
